acceptanceCriteria: Each new trace record stores a closed producer value (for example cli, dogfood, pi-tool) under a schema-version bump, with older records read as producer UNKNOWN.
calibrate and eval reports show counts by producer and can exclude a producer without changing stored records.
body: Filed 2026-10-04 from the V1-0712 output-class inventory (docs/build-log/2026-10-04-v1-0712-output-class-inventory.md), source origin/main a2615609. Idea, not a defect. The trace store feeds ranking, calibrate and eval. Writers include the operator CLI (corvint record), dogfood-record, and the Pi corvint_record_outcome tool, whose task, paths, verification and outcome are chosen by the model (cmd/corvint/pi_tools.go:143-167). The outcome is a closed set (passed, failed, blocked), and the Pi response already labels the write provenance caller-reported, but trace.Record (internal/trace/record.go:31) stores no producer field, so later consumers cannot weigh or exclude model-reported outcomes. Calibrate already treats outcomes as self-reports (outcomecal Stance Unknown).

completion.reason: PR beamfall/corvint#569 merged into main as 6c8b8b3d078fb8c795e3e66604413b46d6bcb8bc. Decision 0430 (PR beamfall/corvint#581, merged as ac818777386bffcbb05290fd9cb97afce86f2a7c) accepts the LTPM-V0-015 and LTPM-V0-016 requirement text; the design is decision 0429. AC1 met: new trace rows are schema 3 with a closed producer (cli, dogfood, pi-tool) that is part of the trace ID. Schema-1/2 rows read as UNKNOWN, which is never stored. Witnesses: TestLTPMV0015ProducerGoldens, TestLTPMV0015ProducerRefusals, TestLTPMV0015LegacyRowsReadAsUnknown and TestLTPMV0015MigrationKeepsProducer. AC2 met: calibrate and eval report counts by producer and take a repeatable --exclude-producer that filters reads without writing (TestCalibrateCountsAndExcludesProducers_LTPM016, TestEvalCountsAndExcludesProducers_LTPM016). Limits retained: producer counts are disclosure only; a downgrade after a schema-3 write needs the documented manual move-aside; full make gate NOT_RUN. Evidence: sha256 at ac818777 of the build log, decision 0430 and decision 0429. Completed by the orchestrator.

title: Trace records carry no producer provenance, so model-reported outcomes are indistinguishable from operator records
